55:  * Usage:
56:  * Request request = druidLeaderClient.makeRequest(HttpMethod, requestPath)

60: public class DruidLeaderClient
61: {
62:   private final Logger log = new Logger(DruidLeaderClient.class);
63: 
64:   private static final int MAX_RETRIES = 5;
65: 
66:   private final HttpClient httpClient;
67:   private final DruidNodeDiscoveryProvider druidNodeDiscoveryProvider;
68:   private final NodeRole nodeRoleToWatch;

70:   private final String leaderRequestPath;

72:   private LifecycleLock lifecycleLock = new LifecycleLock();
73:   private DruidNodeDiscovery druidNodeDiscovery;
74:   private AtomicReference<String> currentKnownLeader = new AtomicReference<>();
75: 
76:   public DruidLeaderClient(
77:       HttpClient httpClient,
78:       DruidNodeDiscoveryProvider druidNodeDiscoveryProvider,
79:       NodeRole nodeRoleToWatch,
80:       String leaderRequestPath
81:   )
82:   {
83:     this.httpClient = httpClient;
84:     this.druidNodeDiscoveryProvider = druidNodeDiscoveryProvider;
85:     this.nodeRoleToWatch = nodeRoleToWatch;
86:     this.leaderRequestPath = leaderRequestPath;
87:   }

89:   @LifecycleStart
90:   public void start()
91:   {

93:       throw new ISE("can't start.");
94:     }
95: 
96:     try {
97:       druidNodeDiscovery = druidNodeDiscoveryProvider.getForNodeRole(nodeRoleToWatch);
98:       lifecycleLock.started();
99:       log.debug("Started.");
100:     }
101:     finally {
102:       lifecycleLock.exitStart();
103:     }
104:   }
105: 
106:   @LifecycleStop
107:   public void stop()
108:   {
109:     if (!lifecycleLock.canStop()) {
110:       throw new ISE("can't stop.");
111:     }
112: 
113:     log.debug("Stopped.");
114:   }
115: 
116:   /**
117:    * Make a Request object aimed at the leader. Throws IOException if the leader cannot be located.
118:    */
119:   public Request makeRequest(HttpMethod httpMethod, String urlPath) throws IOException
120:   {
121:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
122:     return new Request(httpMethod, new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s", getCurrentKnownLeader(true), urlPath)));
123:   }
124: 
125:   public StringFullResponseHolder go(Request request) throws IOException, InterruptedException
126:   {
127:     return go(request, new StringFullResponseHandler(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
128:   }
129: 
130:   /**
131:    * Executes a Request object aimed at the leader. Throws IOException if the leader cannot be located.
132:    */
133:   public <T, H extends FullResponseHolder<T>> H go(Request request, HttpResponseHandler<H, H> responseHandler)
134:       throws IOException, InterruptedException
135:   {
136:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
137:     for (int counter = 0; counter < MAX_RETRIES; counter++) {
138: 
139:       final H fullResponseHolder;
140: 
141:       try {
142:         try {
143:           fullResponseHolder = httpClient.go(request, responseHandler).get();
144:         }
145:         catch (ExecutionException e) {
146:           // Unwrap IOExceptions and ChannelExceptions, re-throw others
147:           Throwables.propagateIfInstanceOf(e.getCause(), IOException.class);
148:           Throwables.propagateIfInstanceOf(e.getCause(), ChannelException.class);
149:           throw new RE(e, "HTTP request to[%s] failed", request.getUrl());
150:         }
151:       }
152:       catch (IOException | ChannelException ex) {
153:         // can happen if the node is stopped.
154:         log.warn(ex, "Request[%s] failed.", request.getUrl());
155: 
156:         try {
157:           request = rebuildRequestForLeader(request);
158:           continue;
159:         }
160:         catch (MalformedURLException e) {
161:           // Not an IOException; this is our own fault.
162:           throw new ISE(
163:               e,
164:               "failed to build url with path[%] and query string [%s].",
165:               request.getUrl().getPath(),
166:               request.getUrl().getQuery()
167:           );
168:         }
169:       }
170: 
171:       if (HttpResponseStatus.TEMPORARY_REDIRECT.equals(fullResponseHolder.getResponse().getStatus())) {
172:         String redirectUrlStr = fullResponseHolder.getResponse().headers().get("Location");
173:         if (redirectUrlStr == null) {
174:           throw new IOE("No redirect location is found in response from url[%s].", request.getUrl());
175:         }
176: 
177:         log.info("Request[%s] received redirect response to location [%s].", request.getUrl(), redirectUrlStr);
178: 
179:         final URL redirectUrl;
180:         try {
181:           redirectUrl = new URL(redirectUrlStr);
182:         }
183:         catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
184:           throw new IOE(
185:               ex,
186:               "Malformed redirect location is found in response from url[%s], new location[%s].",
187:               request.getUrl(),
188:               redirectUrlStr
189:           );
190:         }
191: 
192:         //update known leader location
193:         currentKnownLeader.set(StringUtils.format(
194:             "%s://%s:%s",
195:             redirectUrl.getProtocol(),
196:             redirectUrl.getHost(),
197:             redirectUrl.getPort()
198:         ));
199: 
200:         request = withUrl(request, redirectUrl);
201:       } else {
202:         return fullResponseHolder;
203:       }
204:     }

206:     throw new IOE("Retries exhausted, couldn't fulfill request to [%s].", request.getUrl());

209:   public String findCurrentLeader()
210:   {

212:     final StringFullResponseHolder responseHolder;

214:       responseHolder = go(makeRequest(HttpMethod.GET, leaderRequestPath));
215:     }
216:     catch (Exception ex) {
217:       throw new ISE(ex, "Couldn't find leader.");
218:     }
219: 
220:     if (responseHolder.getStatus().getCode() == 200) {
221:       String leaderUrl = responseHolder.getContent();
222: 
223:       //verify this is valid url
224:       try {
225:         URL validatedUrl = new URL(leaderUrl);
226:         currentKnownLeader.set(leaderUrl);
227: 
228:         // validatedUrl.toString() is returned instead of leaderUrl or else teamcity build fails because of breaking
229:         // the rule of ignoring new URL(leaderUrl) object.
230:         return validatedUrl.toString();
231:       }
232:       catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
233:         log.error(ex, "Received malformed leader url[%s].", leaderUrl);
234:       }
235:     }
236: 
237:     throw new ISE(
238:         "Couldn't find leader, failed response status is [%s] and content [%s].",
239:         responseHolder.getStatus().getCode(),
240:         responseHolder.getContent()
241:     );
242:   }

244:   private String getCurrentKnownLeader(final boolean cached) throws IOException
245:   {
246:     final String leader = currentKnownLeader.accumulateAndGet(
247:         null,
248:         (current, given) -> current == null || !cached ? pickOneHost() : current
249:     );
250: 
251:     if (leader == null) {
252:       throw new IOE("No known server");
253:     } else {
254:       return leader;
255:     }
256:   }
257: 
258:   @Nullable
259:   private String pickOneHost()
260:   {
261:     Iterator<DiscoveryDruidNode> iter = druidNodeDiscovery.getAllNodes().iterator();
262:     if (iter.hasNext()) {
263:       DiscoveryDruidNode node = iter.next();
264:       return StringUtils.format(
265:           "%s://%s",
266:           node.getDruidNode().getServiceScheme(),
267:           node.getDruidNode().getHostAndPortToUse()
268:       );
269:     }
270: 
271:     return null;
272:   }
273: 
274:   private Request withUrl(Request old, URL url)
275:   {
276:     Request req = new Request(old.getMethod(), url);
277:     req.addHeaderValues(old.getHeaders());
278:     if (old.hasContent()) {
279:       req.setContent(old.getContent());
280:     }
281:     return req;
282:   }
283: 
284:   private Request rebuildRequestForLeader(Request source) throws IOException
285:   {
286:     final URL sourceUrl = source.getUrl();
287:     final String previousLeader = currentKnownLeader.get();
288:     final String leaderBase = getCurrentKnownLeader(false);
289:     final String path = sourceUrl.getPath();
290:     final String query = sourceUrl.getQuery();
291:     final URL newUrl;
292:     if (query == null) {
293:       newUrl = new URL(leaderBase + path);
294:     } else {
295:       newUrl = new URL(leaderBase + path + "?" + query);
296:     }
297:     final Request rebuilt = new Request(source.getMethod(), newUrl);
298:     rebuilt.addHeaderValues(source.getHeaders());
299:     if (source.hasContent()) {
300:       rebuilt.setContent(source.getContent());
301:     }
302:     log.debug(
303:         "Rebuilt leader request from [%s] to [%s] path[%s] query[%s].",
304:         previousLeader,
305:         leaderBase,
306:         path,
307:         query
308:     );
309:     return rebuilt;
310:   }
311: }
